ghidra_authority.reason: D54 static and exact-10 authority are complete. S4 is an offline publication/repack gate and S8 is a save-oracle observation gate; none of these remaining gates needs another Ghidra seed or re-export.

capture_provenance.same_boundary_rule: Each live observation and its save object share the same non-empty boundary_token and preserve save_path plus save_sha256.

type2_redraw_delete.receipt: baseline/redraw retain identity and change the ordered path; delete is the same-identity tombstone

membership_lifecycle.receipt: ordered live IDs, ordered save IDs, and ordered typed save {id,type} references are preserved; duplicate-free set equality is required at each boundary; add/remove changes exactly one member

empty_inactive_manager.rooting: producer_rooted or consumer_rooted only; arena_scan=false and cached_address_repair=false; preserve the raw root chain
empty_inactive_manager.receipt: stable candidate container, producer/consumer address, raw descriptor, exact contiguous begin/end/stride bounds, bounded ordered walk, raw army windows, same-boundary save membership, and all fixture IDs at every boundary

ordering.assigned_division_ids: preserve engine order; do not sort in carrier
ordering.scheduled_member_ids: preserve save order; do not sort in carrier
ordering.scheduled_member_refs: preserve typed save {id,type} identity and source order

activation.law: The observer always emits false for the optional lifecycle-acceptance fixtures. Type-1 and type-4 geometry and manager execution/cohesion semantics are statically closed and production-wired; they are no longer fixture activations.

statically_closed_semantics.type1_geometry: ordered +0x70 data with live count +0x7C; +0x78 is capacity only
statically_closed_semantics.type4_geometry: source is the first +0x70 province; target is u32 +0xB8; the pointer-free carrier is exactly [source,target]
statically_closed_semantics.legacy_per_order_stance_aggressiveness: retired schema placeholders; canonical wire values remain unknown and are never promoted as per-order observations
